---
title: Table variant fill
format:
  html:
    respect-user-color-scheme: true
    theme:
      light: [cosmo, table-variant-fill.scss]
      dark: [darkly, table-variant-fill.scss]
---

<table id="variant-table" class="table table-primary">
<thead><tr><th>Header</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>Cell</td></tr></tbody>
</table>

<table id="variant-rows" class="table">
<tbody>
<tr class="table-success"><td>Success</td></tr>
<tr class="table-danger"><td>Danger</td></tr>
<tr class="plain"><td>Plain</td></tr>
<tr class="cell-variant"><td class="table-warning">Warning cell</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table id="self-styled" class="table self-styled">
<thead><tr><th>Header</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>Cell</td></tr></tbody>
</table>
